headline: Touchdown for the Chiefs!
what_happened: On their fourth and final try, P.Mahomes threw a short pass to J.Royals, who caught the ball in the end zone for a touchdown.
who: P.Mahomes threw the pass to J.Royals.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs as they add 6 points to their score. This play increases their chances of winning the game by 11 percent.
